payout_quote: Study Indicator: 12C. Participation Includes: 1 Screening visit, 1 Stay of 7 nights, 2 Outpatient visits. Up to $6,000. Male/Female, Ages 18 to 45. Qualified volunteers may be compensated up to $6,000 for participation.
steps: Open the Dr. Vince Clinical Research studies page and locate the healthy-volunteer listing (Study Indicator 12C, Overland Park, KS).
Apply for the study and pass the screening visit.
Complete the full schedule: the 7-night stay plus the 2 outpatient visits.
Receive compensation of up to $6,000 for participation.
catches: You must qualify as a healthy volunteer (male/female, ages 18-45) and pass screening; not everyone qualifies.
The $6,000 is an 'up to' ceiling tied to completing the full schedule.
Time commitment: a full 7-night inpatient stay plus screening and 2 outpatient visits — a week away from home.
You receive an investigational treatment with real medical risks and side effects disclosed in informed consent.
biggest_catch: Up to $6,000 requires a full 7-night inpatient stay plus screening and outpatient visits, passing strict healthy-volunteer screening (not everyone qualifies), and receiving an investigational treatment with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Healthy volunteers, male/female, ages 18 to 45; must pass screening for Study Indicator 12C.
timing: Compensation paid for participation upon completing the study schedule.
